skills.title: Agentic RAG
skills.description: Give an AI agent control over when, where, and how to retrieve information rather than using a fixed retrieval pipeline.

skills.title: Basic RAG
skills.description: Ground LLM responses in external knowledge by retrieving relevant documents before generation to reduce hallucinations and stay current.

skills.title: Deep Search
skills.description: Answer complex multi-hop questions through iterative cycles of retrieval, reasoning, and gap analysis across multiple sources.

skills.title: Grounded Generation
skills.description: Build trust in RAG outputs through inline citations, out-of-domain detection, and self-correcting retrieval strategies that reduce hallucinations.

skills.title: Hybrid Retrieval
skills.description: Bridge the vocabulary gap between user queries and knowledge base content using hypothetical answers, query expansion, and hybrid search.

skills.title: Retrieval Refinement
skills.description: Improve retrieval quality by reranking, compressing, and filtering retrieved chunks between the vector search step and LLM generation.

skills.title: Semantic Indexing
skills.description: Replace keyword matching with vector embeddings to find documents by meaning rather than exact words, enabling semantic similarity search.

skills.title: Code Execution
skills.description: Let LLMs generate and execute code in sandboxed environments for tasks requiring computational precision like data analysis and visualization.

skills.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration
skills.description: Coordinate multiple specialized agents to solve complex tasks that exceed any single agent's capabilities using supervisor or peer topologies.

skills.title: Plan and Execute
skills.description: Separate strategic planning from tactical execution by having one agent plan and another execute each step for more structured workflows.

skills.title: ReAct Loop
skills.description: Interleave reasoning and action in a loop where the agent thinks, acts, observes, and repeats until the task is complete.

skills.title: Tool Calling
skills.description: Let LLMs interact with external systems by emitting structured function calls that your code executes safely on their behalf.

skills.title: Chain-of-Thought
skills.description: Prompt models to show their reasoning step by step to improve accuracy on multi-step problems like math, logic, and complex analysis.

skills.title: Few-Shot Prompting
skills.description: Include input-output examples in your prompt so the model learns the expected format, tone, and behavior by demonstration.

skills.title: Prompt Chaining
skills.description: Break complex tasks into a sequence of focused prompts where each step's output feeds into the next for more reliable multi-step results.

skills.title: Prompt Optimization
skills.description: Automatically optimize prompts against evaluation datasets instead of relying on manual trial-and-error tuning of instructions.

skills.title: Self-Consistency
skills.description: Generate multiple reasoning paths and take the majority answer to reduce errors from stochastic generation and improve reliability.

skills.title: Cascading
skills.description: Try cheaper models first and escalate to more capable ones only when confidence is low, reducing costs while maintaining output quality.

skills.title: Model Router
skills.description: Route queries to the right model tier based on estimated complexity to optimize cost without sacrificing quality on harder tasks.

skills.title: Semantic Router
skills.description: Classify query intent using embeddings and route to the appropriate handler, tool, or agent pipeline without relying on keyword rules.

skills.title: Guardrails
skills.description: Insert safety layers at input, output, retrieval, and execution points to enforce content policies, prevent harm, and block prompt injection.

skills.title: Self-Check
skills.description: Detect potential hallucinations by analyzing token probabilities and confidence scores in LLM outputs before they reach the user.

skills.title: LLM-as-Judge
skills.description: Use an LLM with a custom scoring rubric to evaluate open-ended outputs at scale, replacing expensive human review with consistent automated grading.

skills.title: Reflection
skills.description: Improve LLM outputs through iterative generate-evaluate-critique-regenerate loops that refine quality without retraining the model.

skills.title: Inference Optimization
skills.description: Maximize inference throughput through batching, KV cache optimization, and model parallelism to reduce latency and serve more requests per GPU.

skills.title: Prompt Caching
skills.description: Reuse responses for repeated or similar prompts through semantic and prefix caching strategies to cut latency and reduce API costs.

skills.title: Small Language Models
skills.description: Reduce model size through distillation, quantization, or speculative decoding while preserving quality for cost-efficient deployment.

skills.title: Conversation Memory
skills.description: Manage conversation state across turns using sliding windows, summaries, or entity tracking strategies to maintain coherent multi-turn dialogue.

skills.title: Long-Term Memory
skills.description: Persist important facts and preferences in external memory stores and retrieve them to maintain continuity and personalization across sessions.
